question: Which company agreed to acquire CyberCatch?

hits.title: InvestorNewsBreaks - Datavault AI Inc. (NASDAQ: DVLT) to Acquire CyberCatch for $94.5 Million in All-Cash Transaction.
hits.snippet: The proposed acquisition is expected to integrate CyberCatch's patented, AI-enabled continuous cybersecurity compliance and risk mitigation platform into Datavault AI's Quantum Private Network ("QPN") GPU ecosystem.

hits.title: NetworkNewsBreaks - Datavault AI Inc. (NASDAQ: DVLT) enters LOI to acquire CyberCatch.
hits.snippet: Datavault AI (NASDAQ: DVLT), a provider of data monetization, credentialing, digital engagement and real-world asset ("RWA") tokenization technologies, and CyberCatch (TSXV: CYBE) (OTCQB: CYBHF), a cybersecurity company offering a patented, AI-enabled platform for continuous compliance and cyber risk mitigation, announced they have entered into a binding letter of intent under which Datavault AI will acquire 100% of CyberCatch in an all-stock transaction valued at about CAD $136.8 million.
